_about: Translations of the Word Builder clues in the paylez-words-*.json exports, keyed by the English clue. Written in this repo rather than delivered with the exports: the lists carry English clues only, and a reader of the site in another language needs the clue in theirs. Read by npm run banks (words.<list>.<lang>.json) and by the server import (translations, entity word). byWord overrides one list's word, keyed <list>:<WORD>, for a clue that would otherwise spell its own answer.
